title: Tdg
description:
A complete Task Dependency Graph document.

Use [`Tdg::validate`] before consuming a document produced by another
tool.

diagnostics.description: Analyzer diagnostics. A document may still be valid with diagnostics.

ext.description: Extension point for downstream tools. Keys should be namespaced.

functions.description: Function nodes, including their basic blocks.

timing.description: Timing models, frequency domains and global caveats.

Address.description: Lowercase hexadecimal address with a 0x prefix.

oneOf.description: The target could not be resolved.

candidates.description: Candidate functions, when a bounded analysis produced any.

BasicBlock.description: A basic block with optional intra-function CFG successors and timing.

size.description: Block size in bytes. Zero means unknown.

successors.description:
Intra-function successors. Calls and cross-context edges are stored in
[`Tdg::edges`], not here.

BlockId.description: Identifies a basic block. Well-formed IDs start with `bb:`.

BlockTiming.description: Timing attached to a basic block.

caveats.description: Assumptions and limitations specific to this block.

cycles.description: Modeled cycle count for the block.

model.description: Timing model ID. Must match a [`TimingModelInfo::id`] when present.

time_ns.description: Derived wall-clock time, when a frequency is known.

CacheParams.description: Cache parameters used by a timing model.

line_bytes.description: Cache line size in bytes, when modeled.

oneOf.description: Strong pattern match, but with assumptions.

Context.description:
An execution context.

Contexts are what make the TDG more than a call graph: a function can be
reachable from several contexts, and edges such as `spawn` and `join`
connect functions to contexts rather than to functions.

ext.description: Extension point. Keys should be namespaced.

frequency_domain.description: Clock domain used for this context.

name.description: Display name, for example a task name or IRQ name.

parent.description: Context that created this one, when known.

priority.description: Runtime priority. The meaning of the number is given by `scheme`.

spawn_edge.description: The spawn edge that created this context.

ContextId.description: Identifies an execution context. Well-formed IDs start with `ctx:`.

oneOf.description: Thread created inside a structured-concurrency scope.
Async task spawned on an executor.
Timer callback executed in a timer-service context.

CostRange.description: A closed interval of modeled cycle counts or nanoseconds.

Determinism.description: Behavioral class of a timing model.

oneOf.description:
Exact for the modeled core and memory configuration, assuming the
documented pipeline rules hold.
A sound min/max range for the modeled configuration; not a WCET proof.

A throughput estimate for an out-of-order or otherwise unpredictable
core. Not a bound.

Edge.description:
A typed edge.

The `kind` field selects the variant. Every edge has an ID, a source/site
and explicit confidence; there are no implicit guesses.

direct.description: Whether the target was resolved statically.

inlined.description: Whether this edge exists only in the logical (pre-inlining) graph.

tail.description: Whether this is a tail call (the call site is a jump).

oneOf.description: Creation of a new execution context.

name.description:
Optional task label recovered from a closure/future type or the
resolved entry symbol.

priority.description: Priority passed to the API, when it is a constant.

runtime.description: Runtime that defined the API, for example `freertos` or `rust-tokio`.

spawn_kind.description: What kind of execution unit was created.

target.description:
Target context, or an explicit opaque target when the entry could
not be resolved.

from_context.description: Context containing the call, when known.

scope.description: Scope that provides an implicit join, when applicable.

target.description:
Context being joined/detached/aborted, or an explicit opaque
target.

oneOf.description: An async task awaits a future/task.

confidence.description:
Resolution confidence. Await targets are often opaque without data
flow.

oneOf.description: Registration of a callback that runs in another context.

runtime.description: Runtime that defines the registration API.

target_context.description: Context in which the callback runs, when known.

oneOf.description: Activation of an ISR through a vector table.

irq.description: IRQ number, when distinguishable from the vector index.

name.description: IRQ/peripheral name, when known (for example from an SVD).

oneOf.description:
Derived preemption relation, usually ISR over thread contexts.

This edge is a projection of priority/scheduling metadata and is marked
`derived` so consumers can ignore it.

derived.description: Whether the edge was derived rather than observed.

EdgeId.description: Identifies an edge. Well-formed IDs start with `e:`.

FrequencyDomain.description: A clock domain. Time is `cycles / hz`.

hz.description: Frequency in hertz. Must be greater than zero.

FrequencyDomainId.description: Identifies a clock/frequency domain. Well-formed IDs start with `clk:`.

oneOf.description: Recovered from an ELF symbol with a known meaning.

blocks.description: Basic blocks, when the function body was analyzed.

demangled_name.description: Demangled name when it differs from `primary_name` or adds information.

ext.description: Extension point. Keys should be namespaced.

inline_sites.description:
Callers for which this function was inlined. Logical call-graph edges
also carry `inlined: true`.

language.description: Source language inferred from symbols/debug info.

primary_name.description: Primary display name. For Rust/C++ this is normally the demangled name.

size.description: Function size in bytes. Zero means unknown.

source.description: Source location of the function definition, when known.

symbols.description:
Raw symbol names. Multiple entries represent aliases or ICF-folded
functions sharing one address range.

timing.description: Aggregate block-cost metadata. Not an execution time.

FunctionId.description: Identifies a function node. Well-formed IDs start with `fn:`.

oneOf.description: Entry point of a thread or async task. Context membership is authoritative.
Poll function of an async future.
PLT entry on dynamically linked targets.
Declared but not present in this image.

FunctionTiming.description:
Aggregate, clearly non-execution-time cost of a function.

This is the sum of the static cost of the function's unique basic blocks. It
is useful for triage and visualization, but it is **not** a path time and
**not** a WCET estimate. Loops and shared blocks make the sum meaningless as
an execution time.

caveats.description: Caveats that apply to the aggregate.

modeled_blocks.description: Number of blocks that carry a timing estimate.

static_block_sum_cycles.description: Sum of the modeled cost of all blocks in the function.

unmodeled_blocks.description: Number of blocks without a timing estimate.

ImageInfo.description: Metadata about the analyzed ELF image.

entry.description:
ELF entry point. For Thumb images this may retain the low interworking
bit.

has_debug_info.description: Whether DWARF debug information is present.

has_relocations.description:
Whether relocation records are present (for example from
`--emit-relocs`).

has_symbols.description: Whether a symbol table is present.

load_segments.description:
Loadable segments, useful for VMA/LMA reasoning and memory-region timing
parameters.

path.description: Path or basename of the analyzed file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, when computed.

caller.description: Function into which this function was inlined.

depth.description: Inline depth, starting at 1 for a direct inlining site.

InstructionTiming.description:
Optional per-instruction timing detail. Producers may omit instructions to
keep documents small; block-level timing is always sufficient for
downstream aggregation.

oneOf.description: Implicit join at the end of a scope.

JoinTarget.description:
Resolution of a join/detach/abort target.

Thread handles are frequently opaque at `-O2` even when symbols are
available, so an unresolved join is first-class rather than omitted.

oneOf.description: The handle could not be resolved to a context.

candidates.description: Candidate contexts, when a bounded analysis produced any.

Language.description: Source language inferred for a function.

raw.description: Raw value as reported by the runtime API.

oneOf.description: Larger numbers are higher priority (`FreeRTOS`, pthread).

implicit_join.description: Whether the scope implies a join at exit.

members.description: Spawn edges belonging to the scope.

ScopeId.description:
Identifies a structured-concurrency scope. Well-formed IDs start with
`scope:`.

oneOf.description: The result may be incomplete or approximate.
The output is invalid or analysis failed for this item.

file.description: Source file path as recorded in debug info.

SpawnKind.description: Kind of execution unit created by a spawn operation.

oneOf.description: Thread scoped to a structured-concurrency region.
Task owned by an executor/driver context.

SpawnTarget.description:
Resolution of a spawn edge's target.

An unresolved spawn is still represented as an edge: the call site is
valuable evidence, and inventing a context/entry would be worse than
reporting an opaque target.

oneOf.description: The created context and its entry were resolved.

entry.description: Entry function of the new context. Must equal the context entry.

oneOf.description: The entry/target could not be resolved.

candidates.description: Candidate entry functions, when a bounded analysis produced any.

TimingInfo.description: All timing information attached to a TDG.

caveats.description:
Global limitations of the timing results (for example "no cache
model").

default_frequency_domain.description: Domain used when a block does not name one.

frequency_domains.description: Clock domains referenced by contexts and blocks.

models.description: Timing models used by at least one block.

TimingModelInfo.description: Describes one timing model/table used by the analyzer.

determinism.description: How trustworthy a cycle count from this model is.

flash_wait_states.description: Flash wait states applied to instruction fetches.

ToolInfo.description: Identifies the producer and the data tables it used.

rules_version.description: Version of the concurrency-detection rule database.
